artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: C36/C37 gates, the sliced interesting witness, and the Tier-2 exclusion record.

completion_data.completion_summary: Landed C36 (non-vacuity with a coverage-limit guard) and C37 (clause-shape check) in scripts/check-module-invariants.sh with their two companion files, exhibited the sliced class's first interesting witness in PlusSlicedCertificate/Examples.lean (C2 now pins thirty rows), and closed the Tier-2 box-dot witnesses with a reasoned exclusion after the checker's liveness fixpoint failed to return; both gate modes print ALL CHECKS PASSED.

memory_candidates.content: PlusSlicedCertificate's computed liveness fixpoint (liveT / liveAt) does not return under compiled #eval at a width-2, total-edge certificate with only 4 coherent positions and 4 window times (targetA/targetB of the lasso examples), while it returns in about a second at the self-loop embedded certificates (liveFamily.sliced). Before attempting any new hand-built sliced witness, time `#eval (G.liveAt t).card` alone under `timeout 300`; if it does not return, kernel `decide` on `Certifies` is unreachable and the checker, not the construction, needs work.

Pattern for a two-half invariant check in scripts/check-module-invariants.sh: the build-free Python heredoc (every mode) parses the companion file once and writes the `#eval` lines into a mktemp file exported as an env var; the RUN_BUILD=1 bash half concatenates a fixed Lean preamble (helpers, opens) with those lines, runs `lake env lean` under the lock C1 already holds, and asserts on `s!"TAG name field=value"` lines. One parser, two halves, no scraping of lake build output, axioms delegated to C2 by a C21-style set-membership check against the BASELINE heredocs read from the script's own text.

A `#guard decide G.Certifies` on a decidable sliced certificate costs about 60 s of build time (the compiled Decidable instance), whereas the kernel `decide` theorem for the same fact elaborates in about 4 s; prefer the theorem alone unless the compiled path is the thing being tested.
